about.title: Where Every Smile Gets
desc: Platinum dental smile was founded with a single purpose: to make world-class dental care accessible, comfortable, and affordable. We combine cutting-edge technology with a gentle, patient-first approach so every visit feels reassuring — not anxious.

Located in the heart of your city, our clinic is designed to feel welcoming from the moment you walk in. Our team of specialists is committed to building long-term relationships with patients and their families.

whyUs.title: Pain-Free Technology
whyUs.desc: Laser dentistry, digital impressions, and conscious sedation options ensure every procedure is as comfortable as possible.

whyUs.title: Transparent Pricing
whyUs.desc: No hidden costs, no surprise bills. We discuss every treatment plan and its cost upfront so you're always in control.

whyUs.title: Expert Specialists
whyUs.desc: Our team includes specialists in orthodontics, implantology, and cosmetic dentistry — all under one roof.

whyUs.title: Flexible Timing
whyUs.desc: Early morning, evening, and weekend slots available. Your dental care should fit your schedule, not the other way around.

whyUs.title: Instant WhatsApp Booking
whyUs.desc: Book, reschedule, or ask questions directly via WhatsApp. No hold music, no long waits — just fast, friendly service.

whyUs.title: Sterilization Guarantee
whyUs.desc: Autoclave sterilization, disposable protective gear, and hospital-grade disinfection after every patient, every time.

doctor.name: Dr. Pooja Nerkar
bio: With over 15 years of clinical experience, Dr. Pooja Nerkar has transformed thousands of smiles across the city. A graduate from a premier dental institution, she brings a perfect blend of technical precision and artistic sensibility to every case.
Her approach is simple: listen first, treat second. She believes every patient deserves to understand their options before any procedure begins.

expertise.title: Clinical Expertise You Can Trust
expertise.note: No unnecessary treatment. No confusing dental terms. Just honest care.

testimonials.text: I had severe dental anxiety before visiting Platinum dental smile. Dr. Pooja Nerkar was so patient and calming throughout my root canal. Honestly didn't feel a thing. I wish I'd found this clinic years ago!
testimonials.name: Rahul Sharma

testimonials.text: My smile designing journey at Platinum dental smile was absolutely life-changing. The doctor understood exactly what I wanted and delivered beyond my expectations. The results are stunning and so natural-looking!
testimonials.name: Priya Mehta

testimonials.text: Brought my 7-year-old who was absolutely terrified of dentists. The staff was amazing with him and made it a fun experience. He actually wants to come back! Highly recommend for families.
testimonials.name: Anil Kumar

testimonials.text: Got my teeth whitening done here and the results were incredible — 7 shades brighter in one session! The team is professional, the clinic is spotless, and booking via WhatsApp was super convenient.
testimonials.name: Sneha Patel

testimonials.text: Had two dental implants placed. The procedure was painless and the recovery was smooth. Six months later and they feel completely natural. Best investment I've made in my health.
testimonials.name: Meena Joshi

testimonials.text: My braces journey of 18 months at Platinum dental smile was seamless. Regular follow-ups, quick responses on WhatsApp, and the final result is a perfectly straight smile. Couldn't be happier!
testimonials.name: Vikram Singh
